Lily didn't want to draw anymore because she was having too much fun drawing. She went to her room and sat on her bed. But she didn't feel comfortable. One day, Lily's mommy came to her room and saw her sad face. She asked Lily what was wrong, and Lily told her about her drawing. Her mommy said, "Don't worry, we can wash it off with soap and it will get better." 

So, Lily's mommy washed the crayons and put them in a bowl to dry. Then, she took Lily to the kitchen and washed her hair with soap. After a little while, Lily felt much better and was able to make her whole picture again. From that day on, Lily was more careful when she drew.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to ride in her dad's car with his big wheel. One day, they went to the store and Lily saw a toy that she really wanted. She asked her dad if she could have it, but he said no because he didn't have enough money to buy it.

Lily was sad and didn't understand why she couldn't have it. But then her dad promised her that they could spend some money on other things like paper and shoes that fit her better. Lily was happy and said yes.

They packed their bags and went to the toy store. Lily saw a book with colorful pictures and asked her dad if she could have it. Her dad said no and told her that they couldn't buy it because it wasn't normal to have things they couldn't afford. Lily was sad and didn't understand why they couldn't buy it.

Suddenly, her dad saw a mark on the ground which said "cheese". He picked it up and put it in his pocket. Lily asked her dad why it didn't fit her and he said it was for her to buy a new one. They went home and Lily was happy again. She knew that she would always remember the fun they had together.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and explore the world around her. One day, she found a big, round apple on the ground. She picked it up and put it in her pocket.

Later that day, Lily went to the park with her family. At the park, she saw a big slide. She wanted to try it, but she was scared. Her mom told her to be calm and hold on tight. Lily took a deep breath and climbed up the slide.

When she got to the top, she saw her mom was waiting for her. She took a deep breath and slid down the slide. It was so much fun! Lily felt so proud of herself for being brave and going down the slide. She told her mom that she wanted to go again and again.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the park with her friends. One day, she saw a big dog with a lot of equipment. It was a useful tool that could lift things up and down easily. 

Lily thought it looked fun, so she started to play with the equipment. She would lift things up and down, and even reverse them! Her friends thought it was funny, so they laughed and clapped. 

Later that day, Lily's mom asked her how her day was. Lily told her about the useful equipment and how she played with her friends. Her mom smiled and said, "That sounds like lots of fun!" And they all went to bed happy. The end.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park with her friends. One day, Lily and her friends were playing catch with a ball. They were having so much fun, but then Lily accidentally dropped the ball and it rolled away. 

"Oh no, my ball is gone!" cried Lily.

Her friend, Jack, gave her a big hug and said, "Don't worry, Lily. We'll find it and bring you a new one."

They went on an adventure looking for the ball. After a while, they found it and Lily was so happy. "Thank you, Jack!" she said.

As they were walking away, Lily's mom called out, "It's time to go home now, Lily. You can play more tomorrow."

Lily nodded and said, "Okay, Mommy." She had so much fun playing with her friends and feeling happy. They all went home and Lily fell asleep dreaming of the fun day she had with her friends.

The little bird was sad because:
The little bird was sad because it had lost its nest. The bird was so gloomy because it always flew away from its nest. One day, a kind rabbit saw the bird and said, "Hey little bird, why don't you take a bath in the lake? It's very nice there."

The bird was happy to hear this and followed the rabbit to the lake. When they got to the lake, the rabbit said, "You look so happy here. Why don't you be happy?"

The bird was so excited! Then it flew to the river and started to splash around. Suddenly, the bird noticed that the river was murky and dark. The bird said, "Oh no! I think I've lost a place to stay here. We shall be more careful."

The rabbit thought for a moment and said, "It's a great idea. We'll find a place where you can stay." So, the bird and the rabbit searched the lake together. After a while, they found a cave. The bird flew in and settled in.

The bird was very thankful to the rabbit and was happy to know that it had been able to find a place to stay. The rabbit said, "It was the most fun that you had ever had. I'm glad that you helped me find a place to stay!"

The rabbit smiled and said, "I'm glad to help. That's what friends do!"
The little bird was sad because it was miserable. It had no one to comfort it.

One day, a big and strong wind came. The wind made the little bird very scared. It flew away from the wind, but it was too late. The little bird was gone.

The little bird was very sad and cried for a long time. It learned that it should never let the wind scare it away. It was never happy again.
The little bird was sad because it wanted to fly high in the sky. It asked its friends for help, but none of them would help. The bird was too sad to fly, and it began to weep.

The bird's friends saw this and wanted to help. They all worked together to find a way to fly. But, they could not find the right place for the little bird to rest. They were all very sad and missed the little bird very much.

Then, a kind man came to help. He had a big box with him. He opened it and found the bird's nest. The bird was happy again and thanked the man. The man smiled and flew away, leaving the little bird safe and sound. The little bird and its friends never saw the big man again.
The little bird was sad because it couldn't fly. It wanted to see the sun and the trees. The bird remembered that its family had given it a feather to carry. It thought it could find a feather too. 

So the bird flew high into the sky and found a feather. It was a beautiful feather, but it was very thick. The bird was proud of its feather. It flew back down to its family. 

On the way, the bird let its feather down and it kept looking for more things to carry. The bird found some trees and a grass to carry. Then it flew back to its nest and let the feather carry it.

The bird was happy to have found the feather. It knew that it could always find something to bring it to the sky.

The dog sat down and saw the bird was sad. The dog wanted to help the bird. The dog had an idea. He wanted to lift the bird's wings. The dog tried to lift the wings, but he could not. The dog was angry and wanted the bird too.
